newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY EIGHT SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY EIGHT SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the eighth day of the French Open:
Best quote - "I have yellow socks, blue shoes -- but my underwear is white," said Brazilian Gustavo Kuerten, when asked if he had any traditional tennis whites.
Stat of the day - 6. The number of unseeded players in the men's last eight
Old lady of tennis - Steffi Graf, who will not be 28 until Saturday week, finds herself the oldest player in either the men's or women's quarter-finals at Roland Garros.
